title: Qatl e ali pe eid manate hai musalman
body:
Qatl e ali pe eid manate hain musalmaan
Dil aal-e-payambar ka dukhate hain musalman
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Khud Eid soghwaar hai manzar yeh dekh kar
Kufe ki gali aise sajate hain musalman
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Misl-e-shab-e-aashur shab-e-eid ho gayi..
naqsh e khuda ko haye mitate hain musalmaan
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Kufe me jashn char su mahaul khushnuma..
sadaat ke gham yu'n bhi badhate hain musalman
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Zainab hai muntazir ke ho pursaan e haal kaun
Pursa kya tasalli ko na aate hain musalman
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Zeher e dagha se chaak kiya jigar e hasan ko..
yu'n khoon mustafa ka bahate hain musalman
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Paigham bhej bhej ke karbobala ki samt..
sarwar ko karne qatl bulate hain musalman
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Akbar ka qatl hona mohammad ka qatl hai
Tasweer-e-risalat bhi mitate hain musalma'n
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Aati hai jab bhi EID 'SHABIH' gham manata hai
Khushiya'n dhamaal jashn manate hain musalma'n
